name: PO vs SO
query:
SELECT
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
    so.transaction_date AS "SO Date:Date",
    so.status AS "SO Status:Data",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    pro.item_name AS "Item Name::150",
    po.name AS "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    po.transaction_date AS "Order Date:Date",
    po.status AS "Order Status:Data"
    
FROM
    `tabSales Order` so
INNER JOIN
    `tabPurchase Order Item` pro ON pro.sales_order = so.name
INNER JOIN
    `tabPurchase Order` po ON po.name = pro.parent
WHERE
    po.docstatus = 1;
